correctness.rationale: For every integer n≥3, the exact covering X=Δ_A∪Δ_B∪L follows from the induced component test for mixed faces. Vertex b_i is dominated by a_i in L (and conversely), so L retracts onto either K_n one-skeleton. The two-cell homotopy pushout computes X≃ΣK_n≃∨ binom(n−1,2) S², valid integrally. The pair sequence H₂(X,L)≅V⊕V→H₁(L)≅V is the surjective sum, with kernel the anti-diagonal, naturally acted on by S_n and minus row swap. The exterior-square integral identification is the kernel of the standard edge-boundary contraction; no rationalization gap. Independent exhaustive small checks enumerated all faces n=2..6, mod-two boundaries, and every group character n=3..6. Finite checks are not substituted for the general proof.

Results indexed under crown configurations and rook-neighborhood topology concern other simplicial objects. value.rationale: Higher-independence topology has active 2026 structural questions. Crown graphs are canonical dense bipartite graphs with a missing perfect matching, structurally distinct from complete bipartite graphs and trees. The theorem gives a uniform exact integral homotopy classification for all crown sizes together with an explicit, nontrivial integral S_n×C2 symmetry lattice; an abstract sphere count alone cannot determine that integral action. The exterior-square character offers exact equivariant fixed-class predictions and a basis for studying quotient invariants. It is a mathematically natural infinite-family classification, not a parameter renaming or arbitrary small case.
